title: Close long AUDJPY for a small gain

classification.rationale: The note closes a long AUDJPY spot trade at the trailed stop and discusses the USDJPY outlook and year-end forecast of 165, driven by BoJ hike pricing and US yields.
classification.runner_up_reason: The trade-close and GPIF flow discussion is relevant, but the main argument concerns the spot USDJPY and AUDJPY outlook.
